verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's docs say one agent resolves issues end-to-end across chat, email, voice and SMS, and its homepage adds phone and WhatsApp, so the core chat/email coverage plus WhatsApp is claimed. The other channels in the story are not evidenced: the Slack mention refers to talking to Coach (an internal analytics tool), not customer-facing support, and 'every customer channel' is generic marketing. Missing for 10: in-app messaging support, customer-facing Slack support, social channels (e.g. Facebook/Instagram/X), any channel integration docs, and independent corroboration.
